transcript.en: Loads of people have phoned you.
I felt just like your secretary!
transcript.zh: 我觉得我像是你的秘书

transcript.en: I went into the library this afternoon to have a look at a newspaper and I came across something really interesting.
transcript.zh: 我今天下午去图书馆看报纸，碰巧遇见了一些很有趣的事，

transcript.en: No, a brochure from a summer festival - mainly Spanish music.
transcript.zh: 不，西班牙音乐为主的夏季节日小册子，

transcript.en: They had a video with all the highlights of the festival at a stand in the lobby to the library, so I heard them.
transcript.zh: 在图书馆大厅的架子上有这节日中的一些精彩部分的录像，所以我听了他们的演奏。

transcript.en: They play fantastic instruments - drums and flutes and old kinds of guitars.
transcript.zh: 他们的乐器演奏极好，包括鼓、长笛和老式吉他。

transcript.en: I've never heard anything like it before.
transcript.zh: 我之前从没听过这种演奏

transcript.en: The only problem is there aren't any cheap seats...it's all one price.
transcript.zh: 唯一的问题是没有便宜的座位，都是一口价。

transcript.en: Well, in that case we could sit right at the front - we'd have a really good view.
transcript.zh: 那样的话，我们就坐在前边，这样会看得很清楚。

transcript.en: Yeah, though I think that if you sit at the back.
transcript.zh: 是的，但是我觉得如果你坐在后面，

transcript.en: You can actually hear the whole thing better.
Anyway we can decide when we get there.
transcript.zh: 总之我们可以到那儿再决定

transcript.en: So will you fill in the form or shall I?
transcript.zh: 那么是你来填表还是我填

transcript.en: Do you remember our new postcode?
transcript.zh: 你记得我们的新邮编吗

transcript.en: Just a minute - I've got it written down here.
Do you need the phone too?
So, let's book two tickets for Guitarrini.
If you're sure 7.50 each is all right.
transcript.zh: 如果你觉得每人7.50英镑没问题

transcript.en: How do you feel about the singer?
But I've noticed something on the booking form that might just persuade me!
transcript.zh: 但是订票单上的信息让我能接受这个价格

transcript.en: Singer, ticket £6.00 includes drinks in the garden.
transcript.zh: 歌手，票价6英镑包括花园里面的酒水，

transcript.en: Sounds like a bargain to me!
Yes, let's book two tickets for that.
How about the pianist on the 22nd of June?
I've just remembered that's my evening class night.
transcript.zh: 我刚想起来那天晚上我有课

transcript.en: I'll just have to go on my own - but we can go to the Spanish dance and guitar concert together, can't we?
transcript.zh: 但是我们可以一起去看西班牙舞和听吉他音乐会了吧？

transcript.en: Yes - I'm sure Tom and Kieran would enjoy that too.
transcript.zh: 是的，我肯定汤姆和基兰也会喜欢的。

transcript.en: I can see we're going to have to go without food for the rest of the week - we'll need to book four!
transcript.zh: 我能预见，这周我们都会没饭吃。我们得订4张！

transcript.en: Children, Students and Senior Citizens get a 50% discount on everything.
transcript.zh: 儿童，学生和老人都能享受5折优惠，
